dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: That should just about do it. What hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up with those stairs over there?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: The stairs? Oh, you want to go up to the inn?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: You've come at a bad time, there's two big holes on the way up. To prevent people from missing their step, the boss has had the whole stairway closed.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: The preparations for repairs have been made, but the stairs won't be fit for walking for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Don't worry. You can't use the stairs, but the elevator over there is just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: It can move cargo, so carrying people isn't a problem. If you're in a rush, how about using that instead?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, and while you're at it, help me give this to the boss. It's a gift from a guest.

response.speaker: Zhen Qiang
response.text: Well, off you go, then. Remember to watch your footing. This inn is pretty high up, so falling off halfway is no joke!

choices.text: Why aren't you going up yourself?

response.speaker: Zhen Qiang
response.text: I need to stay down here to receive goods. There's lot of goods to receive, and I daren't make any mistakes.

response.speaker: Zhen Qiang
response.text: Alright, off you get. Watch your footing, now. This inn is pretty high up, and falling off halfway is no joke!
